title: "Extended course – Europeanisation and the economy"
subtitle: "Three days, with a facilitator"
# The three-day course of October 2026 is rebuilt as the Extended course.
---

The Extended course builds two more days around the [one-day workshop](../day/index.qmd) on the Europeanisation and the economy case study. The first day teaches open research and the tools of the course, and it is the same for every case study of AR4DS. The second day is the workshop itself, unchanged. The third day teaches the methods of this case study as taught sessions, from the panel of 27 countries to the respondents within them, and it ends with a report of your own, in which the analysis that you declared on the second day is written up in Quarto and kept under Git.

The case study works on a study of Eurobarometer surveys, which asked whether the economic crisis changed how citizens of the member states frame the European Union, and on a claim of the original author (OA) that five analysts reanalysed for the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026). On the second day you work as analyst no. 6, and the first and third days give that work its context and its methods.

## The days

- **[Before the course](before.qmd).** You install R and the workspace, work through the first module on R, read the background page, and download the Eurobarometer files that the work on respondents needs.
- **[The exercise](exercise.qmd).** The claim, the five analysts, the tasks of the second day with the tool in which each is done, the work that follows the tasks, and what counts as a result.
- **[Day 1 – Open research and the tools](day-1.qmd).** Credibility and the three Rs, SCORE and its robustness study, repositories and data sources, and then R, Positron and Quarto, taught live.
- **[Day 2 – The workshop](day-2.qmd).** The one-day workshop in its four parts: the claim and credibility, the estimand and the causal graph, the reproduction, and robustness.
- **[Day 3 – The methods and your report](day-3.qmd).** Panel data, multilevel models with the respondents of the surveys, and Bayesian estimation, taught on the data of the case study, and then your declared analysis written up as a short report under version control.
- **[After the course](after.qmd).** The page says where to go next in the companion curriculum.

[Start with Before the course](before.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

A two-day version of the course drops the third day and leaves the methods of the case study to self-study, before and after. The same case study is also taught as the [one-day workshop](../day/index.qmd) on its own, as a [short session](../short/index.qmd) of three hours, and as a [self-study route](../independent/index.qmd).
